title: Tune the browser's security envelope
description: Select a browser action and a response-policy profile. See what the browser blocks, what reaches the server, and whether the intended product flow still works.

profiles.label: Permissive legacy
profiles.detail: Broad exceptions preserve old integrations but leave browser authority open.

profiles.label: Compatibility baseline
profiles.detail: Explicit integrations, Lax cookies, no inline scripts, same-origin framing, and CSRF tokens.

profiles.label: Sensitive surface
profiles.detail: Exact CORS, Strict cookies, nonce-based scripts, no framing, CSRF tokens, and Fetch Metadata checks.

scenarios.label: Partner dashboard API
scenarios.brief: An approved partner origin makes a credentialed API request.
scenarios.success: The exact partner origin receives the response with credentials.
scenarios.failure: A legitimate integration is blocked or a broader origin receives private data.

scenarios.label: Attacker origin API read
scenarios.brief: An untrusted origin tries to read a credentialed response.
scenarios.success: The browser withholds the response because the origin is not explicitly allowed.
scenarios.failure: The attacker origin can read private API data in the victim's browser.

scenarios.label: Injected inline script
scenarios.brief: HTML injection introduces an inline script without an approved nonce.
scenarios.success: CSP blocks execution and can emit a violation report.
scenarios.failure: Injected markup executes with the application's origin and user session.

scenarios.label: Hidden admin iframe
scenarios.brief: An attacker embeds the admin page under deceptive controls.
scenarios.success: The frame navigation is cancelled by frame-ancestors.
scenarios.failure: The victim can be tricked into clicking the framed administrative UI.

scenarios.label: Cross-site transfer form
scenarios.brief: A cross-site POST relies on the browser attaching a session cookie.
scenarios.success: The cookie, CSRF check, or Fetch Metadata policy prevents the state change.
scenarios.failure: Ambient authentication is accepted as proof of user intent.
